newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Giordano says no plans for China investor.
newsitem.headline: Giordano says no plans for China investor.

text.p: Giordano International Ltd chairman Peter Lau said on Friday the company had no plans to bring a Chinese investor into the company.
"There are no such plans," he told reporters after the company's annual general meeting. "We have not really been talking to anybody."
Lau said Giordano's corporate strategy did not include the participation of new shareholders in the company at the moment.
"There is no corporate strategy to invite shareholders at this time. There is no reason to do so. We have plenty of funds," he said.
